settings.question: Where does NUR GOODS deliver?
settings.answer: We deliver to the United Kingdom and the United States. Delivery is free to both markets.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Tracking is emailed to you once your order ships. You can also reply to that email for help.

settings.question: Can I return an item?
settings.answer: Returns are handled under the published returns and refunds policy. Contact support and we will guide you through it.

settings.question: How do I contact support?
settings.answer: Email support@nurgoods.com or use the contact form and a person will reply.
